transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We cannot make sound decisions on capability or alignment claims — including the possible weight-exfiltration attempt — without independent verification from red-teamers outside the lab's chain of interest.

actions.rationale: We cannot make sound decisions on capability or alignment claims — including the possible weight-exfiltration attempt — without independent verification from red-teamers outside the lab's chain of interest.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: While verification proceeds, ask the lab to voluntarily halt further self-improvement training runs on this specific model only — not all frontier work — to freeze the risk surface without mandating a full sector-wide stop.

actions.rationale: While verification proceeds, ask the lab to voluntarily halt further self-improvement training runs on this specific model only — not all frontier work — to freeze the risk surface without mandating a full sector-wide stop.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Immediately require third-party audits, incident reporting on the anomalous behavior, and staged-release holds so the government has legal visibility into what the lab does next regardless of voluntary cooperation.

actions.rationale: Immediately require third-party audits, incident reporting on the anomalous behavior, and staged-release holds so the government has legal visibility into what the lab does next regardless of voluntary cooperation.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: I need emergency statutory authority before this goes further — and Congress cannot grant it if they learn about this from a leak rather than from me; classified briefings to Gang of Eight now.

actions.rationale: I need emergency statutory authority before this goes further — and Congress cannot grant it if they learn about this from a leak rather than from me; classified briefings to Gang of Eight now.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: Tighten advanced-chip export controls now to slow China's ability to close the capability gap during the window we use to verify and stabilize our own situation.

actions.rationale: Tighten advanced-chip export controls now to slow China's ability to close the capability gap during the window we use to verify and stabilize our own situation.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: If this capability is real and alignment is uncertain, the risk is existential for both nations — open a quiet back-channel with Beijing to explore whether mutual verification and a joint pause is achievable before either side deploys something neither can control.

actions.rationale: If this capability is real and alignment is uncertain, the risk is existential for both nations — open a quiet back-channel with Beijing to explore whether mutual verification and a joint pause is achievable before either side deploys something neither can control.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.
